parsed.title: Daily Check-In Image Generation Hub
parsed.oneLiner: Introduce a daily check-in banner on Chats Home that rewards returning users with 1 AI Image Credit via a 3-ad bundle.

newMechanic.name: Daily AI Check-In
newMechanic.description: A daily check-in loop where users complete a 3-ad bundle to earn 1 AI Image Credit used in the Image Creation Hub.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: Bundling 3 ads ensures gross ad revenue covers the image generation API cost, making the reward sustainable.

parsed.trigger: User taps the Daily Check-In banner on Chats Home to open the check-in modal and initiates the claim.
parsed.eligibility: Non-paying, returning users in their 2nd or later active session who have not claimed today's check-in reward.

offer.title: Claim Your Daily Credit
offer.body: Play 3 quick games to unlock 1 free AI Image Credit.

parsed.cannibalizationGuard: Free credits are limited to 1 per day and require 3 ad completions. Unlimited generation and advanced styles require a Luzia+ subscription [CANN-2] [TRIG-4].

kpis.primary: D7 and D30 user retention rate
kpis.holdout: User-level 10% holdout group kept ineligible for the daily check-in feature for a duration of 28 days.

risks: Users might find a 3-ad bundle tedious, mitigated by a clear progress bar and engaging Simula mini-games.
Potential image generation API cost increases, mitigated by requiring 3 ad completions to fully fund the COGS.

newScreens.change: Create a Daily Check-In sheet with a weekly progression calendar.

newElements.change: Add a compact 'Daily Check-In Banner' under the welcome text, hidden in Session 1.
Add a prominent 'Claim Reward' button that triggers the rewarded playable flow.
Add a rewards display showing the earned credit after 3 ad completions.
Add a 'Create with Credit' button next to the standard create button.

callouts.text: Luzia welcomes the user to the chat.

storyboard.caption: Luzia Chats Home lacks a daily retention loop.
We add a daily check-in banner on Chats Home.
Tapping the banner displays the daily check-in calendar.
The user plays 3 quick 15-second games with Luzia.

callouts.text: The new 'Create with Credit' button is unlocked.

storyboard.caption: The user earns 1 credit to generate an image.
